cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've reconciled the invoices, just like you: all the blue ones in one drawer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was clearing my desk. Reconcile means match them to the purchase orders.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Blue batch ready for reconciliation. These totals look like estimates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They are. Those aren't invoices; they're quotes for work we haven't ordered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quotes pending orders, then. I'll relabel the drawer.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies filing as reconciliation; B2 exposes that mistake and A3/A5 keep adopting official language without admitting confusion.
